title: Rava bar Ahina
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Menachot 37b, disagreeing with Rav Yosef. He is mentioned as “Bar Ahina” in Kiddushin 51a, where Rava said, “Bar Ahina explained it to me.” Hyman suggests that possibly in Menachot too it was written, “Rava said: Bar Ahina said, a tallit,” etc.; or in Kiddushin it was written, “Rava said: Rava bar Ahina explained it to me,” and the scribe omitted one “Rava,” leaving only Bar Ahina.
